data.one_liner: Widget that generates placeholder text lines for loading states
data.what_it_does: Creates a configurable set of random-width lines that can be animated, used as skeletons while data loads or for empty states.
use_when: Creating skeleton screens for text content
avoid_when: When you need complex skeletons with shapes or images
When performance is critical and you want to avoid random width generation
strengths: Rebuilds with new widths on state change
weaknesses: No built-in support for images or complex shapes
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import the package
